# r/NYKnicks (post by hand; read the sub's self-promotion rules first)

**Title:** Where the New York Knicks stand in The 644, our ranking of all 644 NBA players

**Body:**

The New York Knicks in The 644, our ranking of every NBA player. The top eight by rank, with each player's GRAVITY score (50 is a league-average minute):

- #8 Karl-Anthony Towns 69.3
- #17 Jalen Brunson 64.1
- #27 OG Anunoby 61.7
- #62 Josh Hart 56.4
- #82 Mikal Bridges 53.7
- #163 Miles McBride 46.4
- #206 Jose Alvarado 43.4
- #232 Landry Shamet 42.0

GRAVITY is our one-number player rating: how good, times how often. Every player has a free profile page, and the table filters by team: https://thegravityreport.com/the644/

Happy to answer questions about the method in the comments.
